requirements.statement: World Intelligence query tools are exposed through the Platform MCP dispatch boundary; callers cannot invoke the downstream service outside Platform policy.
The downstream query token is short-lived, audience-bound, and signed by the Platform identity adapter; tenant and subject are derived from the authenticated Platform principal.
The requested purpose is normalized, authorized against the Platform principal's purpose scope, and bound into the signed downstream token.
The signed request ID and W3C traceparent match the outbound headers; child spans preserve the inbound trace ID and parent-span relationship.
The adapter exposes only fixed-resource GET operations and cannot write canonical World Intelligence state.
World Intelligence independently enforces tenant query policy in PostgreSQL, records allow and deny outcomes, and fails closed when policy is absent.
The HTTP client enforces HTTPS outside explicit loopback tests, disables redirects, bounds response bytes and timeouts, and validates response content type and shape.
Authorization failures are non-retryable; transient network and server failures are classified for bounded retry without weakening authorization.
